label: Bible Study
prompt: And as he lay and slept under a _____ tree, behold, then an angel touched him, and said unto him, Arise and eat.
verse: And as he lay and slept under a juniper tree, behold, then an angel touched him, and said unto him, Arise and eat.
note: Burned-out Elijah's first prescription from heaven: a nap, a snack, and a gentle angelic nudge.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my _____.
verse: I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.
note: David sought the LORD and was delivered from all his fears — not some, all.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the _____?
verse: And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine?
note: Ten lepers healed, one came back to say thank you — and Jesus noticed the missing nine.

label: Deep Water
prompt: The king's heart is in the hand of the LORD, as the _____ of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.
verse: The king's heart is in the hand of the LORD, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.
note: Even a king's heart is like irrigation water — God channels it wherever he chooses.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For I _____ not to know any thing among you, save Jesus Christ, and him crucified.
verse: For I determined not to know any thing among you, save Jesus Christ, and him crucified.
note: Paul arrived in Corinth 'determined' to know nothing among them but Jesus Christ, and him crucified.
